scope: Full expanding-window annual historical comparison conditional on the accepted original annual bandwidth and ridge choices; no fresh holdout or broad originality claim
training_rule: For return year y, all monthly moments from November 1965 through November y-1; outcomes matured by December y-1; scales reset to zero and fitted separately each year
holdings_rule: Common accepted R1 pretrade holdings at December 1980; each method carries its own holdings continuously through November 2025; first trade charged; no annual or period reset
frequency_rule: R MASS::mvrnorm with covariance g I, 256 directions; seed 1 must exactly recover author files. Append 256 independent directions from seed 1000+s for nested 1024 features
coefficient_settings: Accepted original prior-year selected bandwidth and ridge, used for all seeds and methods. These are conditional comparisons, not independently retuned competing estimators
larger_dictionary_ridge: Same original ridge; also store double-ridge sensitivity without selecting on evaluation returns
objective_normalization: Divide each geometry objective by its positive theta=0 profiled value. This fixes shrinkage/gradient tolerance in comparable relative units across supervision objectives; retain the exact original economic beta solution
prediction_ridge: Original lambda times trace(prediction Gram)/trace(full economic Hessian) at theta=0 on the same training dates. This matches relative ridge curvature and uses no future outcomes
joint_optimizer: Simultaneous projected theta and preconditioned beta gradient ascent from theta=0 and exact identity beta; beta preconditioner fixed at the initial economic Hessian plus ridge. Raw joint beta and exact final full-refit beta both produce separate paths
geometry_settings_selection: Prespecified here before any new portfolio-path evaluation; engineering prototype informed feasibility. No search over geometry settings or seed selection; retain all variants
primary_estimand: Arithmetic mean of paired annual net utility differences across the three fixed seeds, not utility of an ensemble portfolio

inference.interval: Paired stationary circular bootstrap; recompute mean and population variance; basic intervals with Bonferroni six-contrast adjustment

success_rule: All six primary mean-seed differences positive with adjusted lower bounds above zero for both block lengths; positive individual-seed point estimates for all six comparisons; exposed robustness does not reverse the mean signs. Otherwise improvement beyond the comparison family is not established
rpm_comparison: Only implement from accessible full methods. Institutional abstract is insufficient; document missing full method without inventing a replica
prospective_step_11: Remains cancelled; no automation, trading or external publication
